newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's SNI 96 net profits fall to $25.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's SNI 96 net profits fall to $25.7 mln.

text.p: Morocco's second largest private holding Societe Nationale d'Investissement made a net profit in 1996 of 239.2 million dirhams ($25.7 million) according to provisional results published on Thursday.

This compared with 893.7 million dirhams the year before but an SNI official said the exceptional results for 1995 were attributed to capital gains. Those followed the merger of four cement firms under Lafarge Maroc, held at 50 percent with French Giant Lafarge.
He said turnover for 1996 was 163.2 million dirhams but gave no comparative figure for 1995.
The company, in its statement published in a Moroccan newspaper on Thursday, said it would give the group's consolidated results at the end of April.
One of the 47 stocks listed on the Casablanca stock exchange, SNI has a market capitalisation of 5.8 billion dirhams. It was last traded on March 19 at 710 dirhams.
